version_string.description: The entire IOS-XE version string, for example, '03.13.02.S'.

major_release.description:
The major version piece of the version string.

`major_release` specifies the major version piece of the version string.

The value is an integer and in the example 03.13.02.S the major_release is '3'.

release.description:
The minor release piece of the version string.

`release` specifies the release piece of the version string.

The value is an integer and in the example 03.13.02.S the release version is '13'.

The value is an integer, and in the example 03.13.02.S the release is '13'

rebuild.description:
The rebuild piece of the version string.

`rebuild` specifies the release piece of the version string.

The value is an integer and in the example 03.13.02.S the rebuild is '2'.

train.description:
The train piece of the version string.

`train` specifies the train piece of the version string.

object.description:
The Object is used by `iosxe.version` to define the different version information associated with an IOS-XE system.

Therefore, there are no child entities defined.

item.description: The Item holds information about the version of the IOS-XE operating system.

require.description:
The comparison fields define the version information held within a Cisco IOS-XE Train.

A Cisco IOS-XE train is a vehicle for delivering releases that evolve from a common code base.

description: The `iosxe.version` is used to check the version of the IOS-XE operating system.
